status: AI-drafted by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-11-14 from the pdftotext output of the two hash-verified BAG commentaries. Pending Erhan's review: no reference, quote or expectation here has been checked by a person.
split: dev/pilot only. None of these cases is a held-out test; D1 is the Zwischenbericht 1 demo case, which that report keeps outside the locked test set.
relevance_unit: An evidence item is a verbatim quote (NFC, whitespace folded) on one page of one edition's commentary. A passage covers it when it is from that edition and page and contains the quote. Cases of kind no_supporting_evidence have no items: their Evidence Recall@5 and MRR@5 are undefined, never 0.

cases.origin: Zwischenbericht 1 demo case (Beispielanfrage, p. 3); used before, so dev only
cases.question: Was hat sich zum 1. Juli 2026 bei den Positionen 4700.00 und 1368.00 geändert? Erkläre den dokumentierten Zusammenhang und zeige Belege, Gültigkeit und offene Prüfpunkte.
cases.reference_expectation: 1368.00 rises from 59.4 TP to 64.4 TP because the Auftragstaxe 4700.00 falls by 5 TP from 21.6 TP to 16.6 TP, so the total payment for the newborn screening stays the same (sole provider: no fees for service, the centralisation argument does not apply). In force on 1 July 2026; the 1368.00 tariff stays under evaluation until 30 June 2028 and is to be recalculated in transAL-2.
cases.context_not_required: 2026-07-01 p. 4, section 2.4: the general cut of the Auftragstaxe by CHF 5 (4700.00 is not named there).

evidence.quote: indem der Tarif für die Position 1368.00 von 59.4 TP auf 64.4 TP erhöht wird, da die Auftragstaxe um 5 TP von 21.6 TP auf 16.6 TP reduziert wird
Der Tarif der Position 1368.00 bleibt bis 30. Juni 2028 in Evaluation

cases.reference_expectation: Vitamin D (1006.00), Holotranscobalamin (1727.10) and Vitamin B12 bzw. Cobalamin (1749.00), each cut by 20 %, in force on 1 July 2026. Seven further positions are cut by 10 %.

cases.question: Mit welchen Positionen ist die neue Position 1779.00 nicht kumulierbar?
cases.reference_expectation: Not cumulable with 1777.00 (sFlt-1/PlGF ratio) or with 1474.10 (Zytokine/Adhäsionsmoleküle/-Rezeptoren/-Inhibitoren); 1474.10 can no longer be billed for PlGF. In force on 1 July 2026.

Sie ist auch nicht mit der Position 1474.10 «Zytokine/Adhäsionsmoleküle/-Rezeptoren/-Inhibitoren» kumulierbar.

cases.question: Wie hat sich der Tarif der Position 1619.00 «Procalcitonin» per 1. Januar 2026 geändert?
cases.reference_expectation: Cut from 75.6 TP (set by the 10 % linear cut of 1 August 2022, before that 84 TP) to 63.3 TP, recalculated from transparently reported, plausibility-checked costs; an interim solution until the transAL-2 tariffs take effect. In force on 1 January 2026.

evidence.quote: resultieren in einem neu berechneten Tarif von 63.3 TP
Bei dieser Tarifanpassung handelt sich um eine Übergangslösung

cases.question: Darf die Position 3489.00 bei einer Onychomykose zur Therapieerfolgskontrolle zulasten der OKP verrechnet werden?
cases.reference_expectation: No. For nail fungus the clinical proof of therapy success is considered appropriate; only for fungal infections of skin and hair may the therapy success be confirmed in the laboratory with 3489.00. In force on 1 January 2026.

evidence.quote: Die Position 3489.00 darf somit bei einer Onychomykose nicht zur Therapieerfolgskontrolle zulasten der OKP verrechnet werden.

cases.reference_expectation: January: the 1619.00 cut is an interim solution until the tariffs revised in transAL-2 take effect. July: the cuts of 1 July 2026 are measures brought forward relative to transAL-2; transAL-2, re-tariffing every position except the Schnelle Analysen, continues as planned; the 1368.00 tariff is to be recalculated in transAL-2.

cases.question: Wie hoch ist der Tarif der Position 1034.00 (Alpha-Fetoprotein, AFP) per 1. Juli 2026?
cases.reference_expectation: Neither commentary states this tariff. The July commentary names AFP as position 1034.00 (p. 7, section 3.1, in the rejected GAAD application) without a tariff; the January commentary does not mention 1034.00. The tariff is in the full list, outside this corpus.
